title: PCR Preparation & Gel Electrophoresis
author: Dakota Betz
materials: Make sure all reagents are completely thawed and mixed (vortex mixer) before using; these reagents should all be stored in the molecular lab freezer. To create your PCR Master Mix , combine 8.5 µL, Water + 12.5 µL, Taq Polymerase + 1.0 µL, Forward Primer + 1 µL, Reverse Primer (volumes are scaled; amount for a single sample would be 8.5 uL water, 12.5 uL Taq, 1 uL fwd. primer, and 1 uL rev. primer) into a 1.6 mL eppendorf tube (lab counter, right side). Vortex mix the PCR Master Mix well (~15 sec). Be sure to note each reagent used and the date it was opened in your lab notebook.

steps.title: Prepare Workstation and Tubes
steps.instruction: Clean the workstation and label PCR tubes for samples and a negative control.

substeps.instruction: Clean workstation with 70% ethanol and 10% bleach before and after the protocol.
Label the top of each tube with a short 1-2 letter/number code using an ethanol-resistant pen.
Label the sides of each tube with the short code, gene, or primers used.
Label the negative control and record all sample names in the lab notebook.

steps.title: Scale Protocol
steps.instruction: Scale the protocol for the total number of samples plus 1-2 additional tubes to account for the negative control (e.g., 7 tubes for 6 samples).

steps.title: Dispense Master Mix
steps.instruction: Pipette 23 uL of PCR Master Mix into each PCR tube, including the negative, and close the tubes.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Extractions
steps.instruction: Prepare and verify the order of DNA extractions.

substeps.instruction: Locate DNA extractions and verify they are in the same order as the prepared PCR tubes.
Ensure any frozen extractions are completely thawed.
Vortex mix each DNA extraction for 10-15 seconds.
Re-verify the order of extractions against the PCR tubes.

steps.title: Add DNA to PCR Tubes
steps.instruction: Add DNA extractions to the corresponding PCR tubes, keeping the negative control tube closed.

substeps.instruction: Open an extraction tube and pipette 2 uL of DNA into its corresponding PCR tube.
Close the PCR tube immediately after pipetting.
If increasing DNA concentration for troubleshooting, use 4 uL of DNA extraction and decrease the water in the PCR Master Mix to 6.5 uL (instead of 8.5 uL), noting this in the lab notebook.

steps.title: Mix and Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Mix the PCR reactions and spin them down before loading into the thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Flip tubes upside down and flick a few times on either side to mix.
Spin down tubes briefly (5-10 sec) in a mini-tube centrifuge.

steps.title: Run PCR Program
steps.instruction: Load tubes into the thermal cycler and execute the selected program.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes into the thermal cycler and record the cycler's number/name in the lab notebook.
Log in to the required folder and select the desired program; record folder and program names in the lab notebook.
Confirm the vessel type as 'tubes' and start the program.

steps.title: Perform Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the agarose gel with ladder and PCR products and run the electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 uL of Bioline HyperLadder to the first well of each row.
Add 2 uL of PCR product (including negatives) to the remaining wells.
Run the gel at 120 V for 25 min.

steps.title: Analyze Gel Results
steps.instruction: Visualize the gel in the UV chamber and record results.

substeps.instruction: Place the gel in the UV chamber and turn on the UV light.
Record in the lab notebook which samples amplified the target genes.
Verify that no amplicons are present in the negative control wells; if a band is visible, redo the PCR protocol with new reactions.

steps.title: Clean Up PCR Products with ExoSAP-IT
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic cleanup on correctly amplified PCR tubes using ExoSAP-IT.

substeps.instruction: Place correctly amplified PCR tubes in a frozen PCR tube rack.
Pipette 2 uL of ExoSAP-IT from the cap into each PCR tube, changing tips between every sample.
Spin down the PCR tubes in the mini centrifuge.
Insert tubes into an Eppendorf thermal cycler and run the 'exosapit protocol' program located in 'Jose's Favorites' folder.
